label: Data Type
definition: Root of the CDA data type ontology. A data type describes what kind of content a file holds, independent of its file format and of the experimental strategy used to produce it.

label: Imaging
definition: Files whose primary content is image data, or objects derived from or attached to images.

label: Radiology Imaging
definition: Images acquired by radiological modalities (x-ray, CT, MR, nuclear medicine, ultrasound).

label: Computed Tomography
definition: Cross-sectional x-ray images reconstructed from rotational projections.

label: Magnetic Resonance
definition: Images acquired using nuclear magnetic resonance.

label: Positron Emission Tomography
definition: Images of radiotracer distribution acquired by detecting positron annihilation photons.
mapped_raw_values: positron emission tomography|positron emission tomography image storage

label: Nuclear Medicine
definition: Planar and SPECT images of radiopharmaceutical uptake acquired with a gamma camera.

label: Ultrasound
definition: Images formed from reflected high-frequency sound waves. Single-frame and multi-frame storage classes are the same data type.
mapped_raw_values: ultrasound image storage|ultrasound multi-frame image storage

label: Computed Radiography
definition: Projection x-ray images captured on photostimulable phosphor plates.

label: Radiofluoroscopy
definition: Real-time or cine x-ray images used in fluoroscopic procedures.

label: X-Ray Angiography
definition: X-ray images of contrast-filled blood vessels.

label: Other Imaging Modality
definition: Images from a modality not otherwise represented in this ontology.

label: Digital Radiography
definition: Projection x-ray images captured on a digital detector.

label: Digital Radiography - For Presentation
definition: Digital x-ray images processed and ready for display.
mapped_raw_values: digital x-ray image storage - for presentation

label: Digital Radiography - For Processing
definition: Digital x-ray images before display processing is applied.
mapped_raw_values: digital x-ray image storage - for processing

label: Mammography
definition: Projection and tomosynthesis x-ray images of the breast.

label: Mammography - For Presentation
definition: Breast projection images processed and ready for display.
mapped_raw_values: digital mammography x-ray image storage - for presentation|breast projection x-ray image storage - for presentation

label: Mammography - For Processing
definition: Breast projection images before display processing is applied.
mapped_raw_values: digital mammography x-ray image storage - for processing|breast projection x-ray image storage - for processing

label: Breast Tomosynthesis
definition: Pseudo-3D breast images reconstructed from multiple low-dose projections.

label: Microscopy Imaging
definition: Images of tissue or cells acquired by light microscopy.

label: Slide Image
definition: Digitized microscope slide image, including whole-slide images, however labelled by the source.
mapped_raw_values: slide image|digital microscopy|slide microscopy|vl whole slide microscopy image storage

label: Tissue Microarray Image
definition: Image of a tissue microarray slide carrying many small tissue cores.

label: Radiotherapy Data
definition: DICOM radiotherapy objects that accompany treatment-planning imaging.

label: Radiotherapy Dose
definition: Calculated spatial dose distribution (dose grid) for a radiotherapy plan.

label: Radiotherapy Plan
definition: Prescription, beam and fraction definitions for a radiotherapy treatment.

label: Radiotherapy Structure Set
definition: Contoured regions of interest (targets, organs at risk) for radiotherapy planning.
mapped_raw_values: rt structure set|rt structure set storage

label: Image-Derived Objects
definition: Objects that annotate, transform, display or are derived from images.

label: Segmentation
definition: Labeled regions delineated on an image.

label: Registration
definition: Spatial transformation relating one image frame of reference to another.

label: Real World Value Map
definition: Mapping from stored pixel values to real-world physical quantities.
mapped_raw_values: real world value map|real world value mapping storage

label: Secondary Capture
definition: Images created from a non-DICOM source or screen capture, with limited acquisition metadata.
mapped_raw_values: secondary capture image storage|multi-frame grayscale byte secondary capture image storage

label: Parametric Map
definition: Image-like grid of derived quantitative values (for example perfusion or ADC maps).

label: Key Object Selection
definition: A flagged subset of images or objects with a reason for selection.

label: Annotation
definition: Markup or measurements attached to an image.

label: 3D Model
definition: Three-dimensional surface or manufacturing model.

label: Raw Imaging Data
definition: Unreconstructed acquisition data from an imaging device.

label: Structured Report
definition: DICOM structured report encoding findings or measurements as coded content. All general SR storage classes are the same data type. Filed under Imaging because the format (DICOM), the source category and the source system all place it there.
mapped_raw_values: structured report document|enhanced sr storage|comprehensive sr storage|comprehensive 3d sr storage|acquisition context sr storage

label: Radiation Dose Report
definition: Structured report summarising x-ray radiation dose delivered during an imaging procedure.

label: Presentation State
definition: Instructions for how an image should be displayed.

label: Grayscale Softcopy Presentation State
definition: Window, annotation and shutter instructions for grayscale display.

label: Advanced Blending Presentation State
definition: Instructions for blending multiple image series into one display.

label: Molecular Data
definition: Files whose primary content is molecular measurements or calls derived from them.

label: Sequencing Reads
definition: Sequencing reads, aligned or not, and their indexes.

label: Raw Sequencing Reads
definition: Unaligned reads as produced by the sequencer (FASTQ). No source data_type carries this concept; it is reached only through data_type_ontology_inferred_map.tsv.

label: Aligned Reads
definition: Reads aligned to a reference (for example BAM, CRAM).

label: Aligned Reads Index
definition: Random-access index accompanying an aligned reads file (BAI, CRAI).

label: Sequence Variation
definition: Variant calls and variant-derived products.

label: Somatic Mutation
definition: Tumor-specific small variants (SNVs and indels). Children distinguish pipeline stage.

label: Raw Somatic Mutation
definition: Unfiltered somatic variant calls from a caller.

label: Annotated Somatic Mutation
definition: Somatic variant calls with functional annotation.

label: Masked Somatic Mutation
definition: Somatic variant calls with sensitive or germline-like sites removed for open distribution.

label: Aggregated Somatic Mutation
definition: Somatic variant calls merged across multiple samples.

label: Somatic Variant Index
definition: Index (TBI) accompanying a somatic variant VCF. Covers both small variants and structural variants (about 9% of these files are indexes of structural variant calls), so it is not filed under Somatic Mutation.

label: Germline Variation
definition: Inherited small variants.

label: Combined Nucleotide Variation
definition: Variant calls that do not separate germline from somatic origin.

label: Structural Variation
definition: Large rearrangements such as deletions, duplications, inversions and translocations.

label: Transcript Fusion
definition: Chimeric transcripts joining two genes.

label: Copy Number
definition: Gain or loss of genomic segments or genes. Children distinguish segment type and masking.

label: Copy Number Segment
definition: Genomic segments with an estimated copy number.

label: Masked Copy Number Segment
definition: Copy number segments with germline-associated regions removed.

label: Allele-Specific Copy Number Segment
definition: Copy number segments resolved by parental allele.

label: Gene Level Copy Number
definition: Copy number summarized per gene.

label: Expression Profiling
definition: Quantified abundance of RNA transcripts.

label: Gene Expression Quantification
definition: Per-gene expression values.

label: Differential Gene Expression
definition: Gene expression differences between conditions or groups.

label: Isoform Expression Quantification
definition: Per-isoform expression values.

label: miRNA Expression Quantification
definition: Per-miRNA expression values.

label: Splice Junction Quantification
definition: Read support per splice junction.

label: Single Cell Analysis
definition: Processed single-cell measurement products.

label: Proteomics
definition: Measurements of protein abundance and mass-spectrometry results.

label: Protein Expression Quantification
definition: Per-protein abundance values.

label: Skyline Document
definition: Skyline targeted-proteomics project file.

label: Mass Spectra
definition: Spectra recorded by a mass spectrometer.

label: Raw Mass Spectra
definition: Vendor-format spectra as acquired, before conversion.

label: Processed Mass Spectra
definition: Spectra converted to an open format (mzML, CDF).

label: Peptide Spectral Matches
definition: Assignments of peptides to spectra (mzIdentML and search-engine tables).

label: Protein Assembly
definition: Protein-level inference built from peptide identifications.

label: Spectral Library
definition: Reference collection of peptide spectra used for matching.

label: Alternate Pipeline Output
definition: Results of a re-analysis with a non-standard processing pipeline.

label: Epigenomics
definition: Measurements of chromatin and DNA modification state.

label: DNA Methylation
definition: Methylation level measurements.

label: Methylation Beta Value
definition: Per-probe methylation beta values (0 to 1).

label: Array Intensities
definition: Per-probe signal intensities from a microarray scan.

label: Raw Intensities
definition: Unfiltered scanner output (CEL) from Affymetrix arrays, used for copy number and expression profiling, not methylation.

label: Masked Intensities
definition: Illumina methylation array intensities (IDAT).

label: Intermediate Analysis Archive
definition: Bundle (TAR) of intermediate pipeline outputs not intended as a final data product. In the current data all of these are from copy number pipelines.

label: Reports and Supplements
definition: Documents describing patients, specimens or findings.

label: Clinical Supplement
definition: Submitted clinical data file.

label: Biospecimen Supplement
definition: Submitted biospecimen data file.

label: Pathology Report
definition: Report of a pathologist's findings.

label: Supplementary Material
definition: Author-supplied supporting documents and tables (spreadsheets, Word, PDF, text). Reached via the context map only.

label: Quality Metrics Report
definition: Report of quality-control metrics for a run or sample. Reached via the context map only.

label: Content Not Specified
definition: Fallback for source values that describe a file's format, licensing or container rather than its data content. These 7 values are all from PDC, and the file category resolves them (see data_type_ontology_context_map.tsv). Use this term only when no category is available.
